reframed_request: Type S (sell X by date Y). Verbatim: «Нужно продать цифровые пианино до Нового года.» Ladder: sell digital pianos → more of the likely buyers in Astana and across RK (delivered) write to Muzzone about a specific in-stock model → they buy → BUSINESS OBJECTIVE: extra digital-piano units sold and attributed between 2026-10-12 and 2026-12-31, focused on models with several units in stock (site stock read 2026-10-08: Estrada EDP-220BK 9, Casio PX-S1100BK 5, Casio AP-300WE 4, Kurzweil CUP E1/M1 3 each, Casio AP-300BK 2; Casio PX-770 and AP-270 also listed in stock, quantity unknown). Across the 25 sampled piano listings there are about 34+ units over 14 in-stock SKUs, and 11 SKUs are out of stock. Assumed target until the owner answers: 10 attributed piano sales, which at an assumed 20% inquiry-to-order rate means about 50 coded piano inquiries, about 5 a week. We have about 11.5 weeks, which is enough to back-plan properly: explore Oct 12–25 → focus Oct 26–Nov 22 → scale Nov 23–Dec 20 → conversion push Dec 21–31. Mix is 50/35/15 (reach / proof+utility / conversion) until Dec 20, then 30/30/40. Each post gets an arm, a WA code and a decision date. Default bottleneck (low confidence, no chat sample yet): consideration. This is a high-ticket purchase (200 720 ₸ to 2 075 617 ₸ for in-stock models), so buyers compare models and shops and fear choosing wrong, and content's job is help with choosing plus proof. A second line runs alongside: model-name and comparison videos on the YouTube channel, which has been dormant since 2026-05-10 (L002/L004). These are search-driven and serve buyers in the research phase.
business_objective: Sell more in-stock digital pianos (priority: models with ≥3 units on the site: Estrada EDP-220BK, Casio PX-S1100BK, Casio AP-300WE, Kurzweil CUP E1/M1) by 2026-12-31, attributed through WhatsApp codes. Assumed target: +10 attributed units over the baseline (target_basis: assumed, to be replaced by the owner's number from Q1). Baseline weekly piano sales will come from tracking piano stock_qty on the site week to week, with no owner minutes needed.
marketing_objective: GET people in Astana (and RK buyers using free delivery over 100 000 ₸) who are about to buy a first or replacement digital piano, mainly parents whose child has started music lessons or who want the piano as a New Year gift, and adult beginners. WHO CURRENTLY (assumed, to verify in chats) can't tell why one 88-key piano costs 200 000 ₸ and another 750 000 ₸, are afraid of overpaying or buying 'не то' (the keys feel wrong, the teacher won't approve, it breaks after the guarantee), and so put off the decision or default to the cheapest listing they find. TO see Muzzone as the place that helps them pick the right model for their situation and budget, with real sound, 100% original stock, a minimum 12-month warranty and a 14-day return, and to write in WhatsApp with a piano code. BY [SMP to be set in C7; if the evidence is thin, it comes from a 2-week exploration across the top 3 insights].

success_metric.name: Digital pianos sold and attributed to content
success_metric.how_measured: One WA code per video (e.g. ПИАНИНО1…). Whoever answers WhatsApp logs code → sold Y/N each week (≤2 min). Cross-check: weekly drop in site stock_qty for promoted piano SKUs vs unpromoted ones (weak, difference-in-differences). Until there are ≥10 coded inquiries in 4 weeks, the primary experiment metric is the E-score (√(rel_reach × rel_actions)) against the pooled music-retail median, labelled as a hypothesis. After that it switches to coded piano WA inquiries per 1k reach.
success_metric.target: Assumed: 10 attributed piano sales ≈ 50 coded piano inquiries (assumed 20% inquiry-to-order). Checkpoints: ≥10 coded inquiries by 2026-11-22. If missed: run R7 funnel check (CTA, WA reply time, trust shelf) before making more content, and propose an owner-approved non-discount offer. Tail: ≥1 post at ≥5× median by 2026-12-20 (likely, not guaranteed).

leading_indicators: Hold3 (1 − skip rate) and average watch % on piano posts vs pooled median (R1 rescue at rel_hold3 < 0.7 at T+48h)
Saves per 1k reach on choosing/utility piano posts (e.g. 'какое пианино ребёнку в музыкалку'), the best signal for a considered purchase
Shares per 1k reach (parent → partner/grandparent; teacher → parents)
Coded piano WA inquiries per week, and the share that names a specific model
YouTube search views on model-name/comparison piano videos (L002/L004 line)
Profile visits and wa.me link clicks per 1k reach
WA median reply time on piano inquiries (guardrail: >60 min = conversion problem, not content)
Weekly change in site stock_qty for promoted vs unpromoted piano SKUs
constraints: Paid budget: 0 ₸ (default). No boosts unless the owner approves a budget plus a max cost per coded chat.
Owner: no direct contact yet; all asks go through Andrey (MetaPrompt) and Pavel. ≤15 min at onboarding, ≤5 min/week. Approval latency is a risk, so batch approval is due each Wednesday.

Worker: ≤20 min/week, one weak phone, audio usable only when the phone is held close. For pianos, record near the speakers/keys or use the line-out only if that needs no extra gear (otherwise no live audio).
People on camera: unknown → default hands and process only, no faces or voices of staff or customers. No children on camera (piano-for-kids content is aimed at parents, not children).

Prices: only site prices with fetch date and a 7-day TTL, re-verified before each publish (e.g. Casio PX-770 BKC7 — 695 913 ₸ as of 2026-10-08). Price only inside a story (E08/E11/E20), never as a slide (L005).
Stock: never say 'в наличии' or 'последний' without a re-check on publish day. Never promote any of the 11 out-of-stock piano SKUs.

Delivery: free ground delivery across RK over 100 000 ₸ and free Astana courier at >20 kg and >15 000 ₸, both quotable as published. No 'доставим к Новому году' claim unless the owner confirms cut-off dates (Q3).

Offer: none new. Existing published discounts (e.g. Gewa UP365, Kurzweil M100SR) may be referenced as published, with no end date and no scarcity. Do not use the words 'Финальная распродажа' and do not build urgency on them until the owner explains them (Q2).

Warranty/returns claims must match the site exactly: minimum 12-month warranty; Casio 2-year manufacturer warranty but service only in Almaty (disclose this if asked, never hide it); 14-day return with delivery cost both ways withheld, so 'без лишних вопросов' cannot be used without the conditions.
Competitors: never named. Category comparisons (digital vs acoustic, 88 weighted keys vs not) only when factual.
Topics to avoid: politics, religion, ethnicity, language politics. Kazakh copy only after native check.

Accounts: YouTube exists (3 620 subs, dormant since 2026-05-10); Instagram exists (not analysed, blocks fetch); VK and FB exist; TikTok unknown; Kaspi shop unknown (Kaspi payment methods only). Business accounts mean commercial-library music only, but piano content can use its own sound.
Approval: explicit one-tap approval of each weekly batch. Anything with claims, prices or discounts needs explicit approval.

Dates: New Year 2026-12-31 (gift moment; the push window is Dec 21–31); school winter break starts late December; Black Friday 2026-11-27 and any Kaspi sale events need verifying before use; music-school term already running (pupils who need a home instrument).
assumptions: Target of +10 attributed piano sales and a 20% inquiry-to-order rate are invented placeholders. Affects: inquiry targets and the feasibility verdict. Revisit: when the owner answers Q1 and the WA chat sample arrives.

Priority models are those with ≥3 units on the site (Estrada EDP-220BK, Casio PX-S1100BK, AP-300WE, Kurzweil CUP E1/M1). This was inferred from stock counts, not margin. Affects: which SKUs get proof/utility and conversion slots. Revisit: money-map screenshot or Q1.

Bottleneck is consideration (choice confusion and fear of overpaying on a high-ticket item), not awareness or conversion. Confidence is low because there are no chats or analytics. Affects: content mix toward E11/E06/E08/E09/E03. Revisit: chat sample (where chats die, reply time).
Main buyers are parents of music-school pupils and New Year gift buyers, plus adult beginners. Affects: audience definition and moment bank. Revisit: chat and review clustering in step C.

'Финальная распродажа' is treated as unexplained and may signal closure or brand exit. Affects: whether warranty/after-sales claims are credible and whether any real deadline exists. Revisit: Q2. If the store is closing, warranty promotion and the whole trust angle must be re-checked.
No TikTok account exists. Plan to open one as the primary test surface, plus Reels and a reactivated YouTube (Shorts plus model-name long-form search videos). Revisit: onboarding card answer.
Site stock_qty is accurate enough to give a weekly sales baseline and a difference-in-differences signal. Revisit: if the owner says site stock is not synced with the shop floor.

Fulfilment is not the bottleneck: piano stock is available (about 34+ units across in-stock SKUs), so demand can be pushed for in-stock models. Revisit: weekly stock check; R9 guardrail if promoted SKUs run out.

Judgement call beyond the method: the site offers delivery-cost compensation 'за честный отзыв в соцсетях или видео', which may count as an incentivised review under platform rules. We will not use or promote it, and we will flag it to the owner.
clarifying_questions: «Что для вас победа к 31 декабря: сколько цифровых пианино и каких моделей? По умолчанию: продвигаем модели, которых на сайте несколько штук в наличии (Estrada EDP-220BK, Casio PX-S1100BK, Casio AP-300WE, Kurzweil CUP E1/M1), цель — +10 продаж по кодовым словам из роликов сверх обычных. Верно? Ответ до 10.10, 18:00; без ответа — работаем по умолчанию.»

«Почему именно до Нового года, и что означает «Финальная распродажа» на сайте: магазин закрывается, бренд уходит или это сезонная акция со сроком? По умолчанию: в роликах нет дедлайнов и слова «распродажа», скидки упоминаем только как на сайте, без срока. Ответ до 10.10, 18:00.»
«До какой даты заказа вы точно доставите пианино к 31 декабря — по Астане и в регионы? По умолчанию: ни в одном ролике не обещаем «успеем к Новому году». Ответ до 10.10, 18:00.»
push_back:
Our honest read: it's realistic to sell more pianos by New Year, but the number is the owner's call, not ours. We have no sales baseline, chat data or margin data yet, so "+10" is a placeholder. Five points:

1. **Organic reach takes time.** It is not a switch, especially for an item costing 200 000 to 2 000 000 ₸ with a research phase of several weeks. So we start now, use the first two weeks to find out what works, and save direct selling for the last 10 days.

2. **Restart YouTube.** It is the best asset we have. Plain model-name and comparison videos already pull search traffic on this channel (L002/L004), but nothing has been uploaded since May.

3. **Problems content can't fix:**
   - 11 of the 25 piano models we checked are out of stock, so we will only promote models that are in stock.
   - WhatsApp reply time is unknown. If piano inquiries wait more than an hour, that needs fixing before any video.
   - The unexplained "Финальная распродажа" banner may make buyers doubt a 12-month warranty.

4. **One thing to stop.** Offering to refund delivery in exchange for a review may break platform rules on incentivised reviews. We won't use it, and we recommend taking it off the site.

5. **No pressure tactics.** No invented deadlines or "осталось 2 штуки" unless the stock and the date are real and confirmed.

Message for the boss: «Продать пианино к Новому году — реально, но не одним вирусным роликом: мы покажем, как выбрать пианино ребёнку и чем модели реально отличаются по звуку, и будем считать обращения по кодовым словам. Дедлайн и скидки — только настоящие.»
